statement.p: A watchs wholesale price was {\$260.00}. The retailer marked up the price by 35\%. Whats the watchs new price (markup price)?

solution.p: First, we need to find the amount of increase in price. Its given that the watchs price was marked up by 35\% of its original price, {\$260.00}.
The problem can be boiled down to this question: What is 35\% of 260? We will show multiple methods to solve this problem.
We will use proportion to solve this problem. Assume 35\% of 260 is x, so 35 out of 100 corresponds to x out of 260.
We will write and solve the proportion:
The amount of price increase was {\$91.00}, so the new price is {\$260.00}+{\$91.00}={\$351.00}.
So the watchs markup price is {\$351.00}.
We will use the percentage formula to solve this problem. This translation from English to math may help you remember the percentage formula.
The question is: What is 35\% of 260? Assume x is 35\% of 260. We have:
The amount of price increase was {\$91.00}, so the new price is {\$260.00}+{\$91.00}={\$351.00}.
So the watchs markup price is {\$351.00}.
